data.title: 久岛鸥 · 秘密洞窟前的烛光相遇
data.description: 潮水退去的岩石洞窟入口，海浪在脚下沙沙作响。鸥举起提灯照亮潮湿的岩壁，回过头向落后的同伴伸出手，水手裙摆在幽暗的洞口宛如一朵静谧绽放的白花。
data.location: hidden sea cave entrance surrounded by tide pools and dripping mossy stalactites
data.action: holding brass hurricane lantern aloft illuminating wet stone walls, extending her free hand toward partner with a gentle inviting smile
data.lighting: warm flickering golden lantern flame cutting through mysterious cool ocean shadows
data.mood: romantic childhood exploration, secret shared world, sweet protective warmth
data.promptProse: Holding a glowing lantern inside a tide cave, Kamome reaches out her hand with a sweet inviting expression, her sailor dress gleaming warmly.
data.animaCaption: Kamome holding a warm lantern in a sea cave, inviting her companion inside.
